semester-planning.prompt: Read ${LOCAL_SKILLS}/semester-planning.md for full instructions. Automate ADO OKR hierarchy setup for a new semester transition. This includes: (1) duplicating CMD Fundamentals Objectives under the target area path, (2) re-parenting existing KRs using REST API relation swaps, (3) updating query filters to include new work item types, (4) updating dashboard widget queries to the new iteration path. Follow all gotchas documented in the skill (relation swap for re-parenting, owner-sync-function mitigation, dashboard team context). Save summary to OneDrive semester planning folder.
semester-planning.inputPrompt: What semester transition? (e.g., 'H1 to H2 for Meeting Join', 'update Fun Execution dashboard from H1 to H2')
semester-planning.description: Set up ADO OKR hierarchy for new semester: duplicate Objectives, re-parent KRs, update queries and dashboards

microsoft-connect-writing-distill-voice.prompt: Read ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/skills/microsoft-connect-writing.md sections 1-2 for full instructions. Distill the prior manager's voice/style for one direct report using the Nuwa-Skill 6-parallel-subagent method on N historical Connect manager comments. Pull historical comments via CDP from msconnect.microsoft.com/viewhistory and v2.msconnect.microsoft.com/historyrag, launch 6 parallel subagents (opener / pivots / vocabulary / grammar / standing KRs / closer), apply the 3-layer verification matrix (frequency + co-occurrence + counter-evidence), and save the frozen mental model + voice template + standing KRs to OneDrive: 1-MSTeamsFiles/0-EM/connect/{YYYY-MM-DD}/{report}_all_manager_comments.md.
microsoft-connect-writing-distill-voice.description: Distill prior manager's voice from N historical Connects via Nuwa 6-subagent method

microsoft-connect-writing-draft.prompt: Read ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/skills/microsoft-connect-writing.md sections 1-4 for full instructions. Draft Past + Future manager comments for one direct report. Step 1: read the current form state via CDP (port 9223) on v2.msconnect.microsoft.com/manager/{pernr} - never draft without reading first. Step 2: pull the prior cycle's Future from viewhistory and run gap analysis (Met / Partially / Missed / Carried-forward). Step 3: apply the distilled voice template if one exists at OneDrive {report}_all_manager_comments.md (otherwise use the Madhu-style structure: 6-paragraph Past with consolidated achievement + However + opportunities-to-deepen; Future with KR scaffolding). Step 4: tone-calibrate for performer level (SWE 2 floor / Senior typical / Principal multiplier). Step 5: save the draft to local scratch C:/src/tmp/connect-{report}/draft.md - DO NOT push yet.
microsoft-connect-writing-draft.inputPrompt: Which direct report and cycle? (e.g., 'Rachita Bansal, May 2026')
microsoft-connect-writing-draft.description: Draft Past + Future manager comments with gap analysis, distilled voice, and performer-level tone calibration

microsoft-connect-writing-push.prompt: Read ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/skills/microsoft-connect-writing.md sections 1, 5, and 6 for full instructions. Push the prepared draft from C:/src/tmp/connect-{report}/ to the Connect form via Edge CDP on port 9223. Use the push script template: fresh Edge process per push (kill msedge first to avoid React state desync), navigate to v2.msconnect.microsoft.com/manager/{pernr}, wait for textboxes to mount, write Past (index 0) and/or Future (index 1) via innerHTML + InputEvent + ChangeEvent + blur, click Save as draft, wait 30s, then verify via fresh WebSocket reconnect + reread with content marker checks (not just length). If markers fail, retry once with fresh Edge - do not retry on the same tab. If <2 textboxes after 80s, report status-locked (form moved off In-Review).
microsoft-connect-writing-push.inputPrompt: Which direct report, and push Past / Future / Both?
microsoft-connect-writing-push.description: Push prepared Past/Future draft via Edge CDP with fresh-Edge-per-push pattern and content-marker verification

microsoft-connect-writing-suggest-krs.prompt: Read ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/skills/microsoft-connect-writing.md section 4 for full instructions. Generate per-IC KR scaffolding for one direct report. Inputs: (a) the manager's standing KRs (from distilled voice file if available, or Naveen's standing requirements as fallback), (b) the report's level and current scope. Apply the EM-to-IC translation matrix (ambiguous->quantitative, centralized->distributed), produce the standard 8-KR list (reliability / hygiene / feature ownership / predictability / throughput / innovation / design discipline / AI adoption) calibrated to performer level (SWE 2 floor, Senior typical, Principal multiplier with 3 extra KRs for architecture/mentor/partner-review). Output as <ul><li> HTML ready for direct paste into Future innerHTML.
microsoft-connect-writing-suggest-krs.inputPrompt: Which direct report and target level? (e.g., 'Rachita Bansal, SWE 2'; 'Raimond Sinivee, Principal')
microsoft-connect-writing-suggest-krs.description: Generate per-IC KR list translated from manager standing KRs with performer-level calibration
